text: {"lessons":["A gain since my purchase price is not, by itself, a reason to sell; decide based on future prospects and my overall portfolio.","Small account-value changes over a few periods are noisy, so I should avoid reacting to them as if they predict what comes next.","Judge each holding by its role and risk in the whole portfolio, rather than treating it as a separate account or resisting a sale just to avoid admitting a mistake."]}
